proposals.title: Item 4 – Amending Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to enable shareholders to combine shares to equal 3% of stock held continuously for 3 years to access proxy access, removing the 20-shareholder cap.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: Item 5 – Report on Political Expenditures Congruency
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Pfizer to publish an annual report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures are congruent with the company's purpose and publicly stated values and policies.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 6 – Report on Transfer of Intellectual Property to Potential COVID-19 Manufacturers
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to commission a third-party report on the feasibility of transferring IP and know-how so additional manufacturers in low- and middle-income countries can produce COVID-19 vaccine doses.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 7 – Report on Board Oversight of Risks Related to Anticompetitive Practices
proposals.proponent: Sisters of St. Francis Charitable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to report on how it oversees risks related to anticompetitive practices, including board oversight responsibility and its role in public policy activities on such risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 8 – Report on Public Health Costs of Protecting Vaccine Technology
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Commons, on behalf of the John Bishop Montgomery Trust U/A DTD 4/4/2019
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to report on public health costs of limited sharing of COVID-19 vaccine technology and how those costs may affect returns to diversified shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
